import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,5); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# robot body
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((3,1.5),3,1.2,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(4.5,2.1,'ROBOT',ha='center',fontsize=10)
# wheels
for x in [3.2,5.5]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,1.0),0.6,0.5,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(4.5,0.6,'drive dir ->',ha='center',fontsize=9)
# cameras
ax.plot([6,7.5],[2.6,3.5],'k-'); ax.text(6.6,3.4,'fwd cam',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([3,1.8],[2.4,1.2],'k-'); ax.text(1.0,1.0,'dig cam',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([3.2,2.0],[1.8,3.0],'k--'); ax.text(4.6,3.4,'mast cam',fontsize=8)
# bin with fiducial
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((8,1.0),1.2,1.0,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(8.6,0.7,'BIN',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.text(8.6,1.6,'+fiducial',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('blind ops: cameras + fiducial + watchdog stop')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
